RFC2545-3-1.note: RFC2545 Section 3: "A BGP speaker shall advertise to its peer in the Network Address of Next Hop field the global IPv6 address of the next hop, potentially followed by the link-local IPv6 address of the next hop." Read all nine current carriers. Announce/default-originate positives and conf-llnh-update.ci require global-then-link-local exact wire; new-v6.ci requires global alone; adj-rib-in-replay-rfc2545-next-hop.ci requires pair preservation on both live and explicit replay arrivals. Session guards require ErrNextHopUnencodable and empty socket for IPv4/unset first address and a global second address. The third-party static negative requires global-only and rejects the speaker-owned link-local after another router global. These are not whole-clause enforcement: TestSendAnnounceRefusesUnusableIPv6NextHop tests netip.Addr{}, not actual IPv6 ::, and no tagged carrier tests multicast first addresses. Producer internal/component/bgp/reactor/reactor_wire.go::nextHopGlobalOctets, lines 116-123, admits actual :: and ff02::1: both pass Is6/not-Is4In6 and internal/core/bgp/attribute/nexthop_form.go::ValidateGlobalNextHop rejects only link-local unicast. Read Peer.SendAnnounce -> Session.SendAnnounce -> validateAnnounceNextHop/writeAnnounceUpdate -> bufWriter.Write/flush; the peer-own gate does not reject those values for an ordinary peer. [INFERENCE] They can therefore be emitted as the first IPv6 next-hop address, although neither is a global unicast next-hop router. Section 2 equates site-local and global within unicast scope, not unspecified or multicast. This is an existing implemented producer defect with missing invalid-input isolation, not an absent-feature request. Downgrade enforced to weak; no gap/partial annotation exists and no speculative source fix is proposed. Independent source rejudgment 2026-10-06, full RFC and all current carriers read. Scoped git diff HEAD is empty for both moved positive carriers and reactor_wire.go, forward_next_hop.go and nexthop_form.go: these are preexisting stale judgment debt/defects relative to HEAD, not introduced by the current mechanical edit. No test, mutation, build, lint, formatter, canonical stamp or live named-peer run was executed. FRR execution remains pending; classify panic records prove reachability only.

RFC2545-3-2.note: RFC2545 Section 3: "The value of the Length of Next Hop Network Address field on a MP_REACH_NLRI attribute shall be set to 16, when only a global address is present, or 32 if a link-local address is also included in the Next Hop field." Read all eight current covers. new-v6.ci requires complete frames with 800E26 0002 01 10 and one address; conf-llnh-update.ci requires 800E36 0002 01 20 and both addresses. Announce, direct-session and default-originate positives independently construct expected length-32 MP_REACH bytes at a socket. The replay fixture checks length 32 on both live and explicit stored replay, with observer ordering/causality. writeAnnounceUpdate derives 16/32 from the second address, UpdateBuilder.buildMPReach preserves order, MPReachNLRI.WriteTo uses the summed length and relay writeMPReach emits len(nextHop). Exact assertions distinguish both length branches. Non-link-local-second rejection is primarily 3-1 evidence rather than an isolated length violation; the separate global-only fixture supplies the length contrast. Registered checkRFC2545NextHops additionally checks exact FRR two-entry global/link-local versus sole-global sets and surviving session, but is not claimed executed. Retain enforced for length clauses only, not all RFC2545 behavior. Independent source rejudgment 2026-10-06, full RFC and all current carriers read. RFC2545-3-3.note: RFC2545 Section 3: "The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if and only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to." Also: "In all other cases a BGP speaker shall advertise to its peer in the Network Address field only the global IPv6 address of the next hop (the value of the Length of Network Address of Next Hop field shall be set to 16)." Read all eight current covers: announce/default-originate pairs, both compatibility .ci files and both FRR checker tags. Socket pairs require length 32 for configured speaker-owned global and length 16 plus absence of pair for off-link destination. Functional/FRR next-hop-off-link negatives also change ownership from speaker-owned to third-party; link_scope.go::linkLocalNextHop returns for third-party before SharesSubnet, so those negatives cannot independently discriminate the global-subnet check. Compatibility configs change local-address too (fd00::2 versus ::1). Existing producer defect: internal/component/bgp/reactor/forward_next_hop.go::egressNextHopGlobalHalf, lines 387-405, returns immediately when destOnLink is true without examining the received global entity. Both forwardUpdateSection and reactorForwardRSSection consume this function; next-hop unchanged/auto preserves the received pair. [INFERENCE] A received global-plus-link-local pair whose global entity shares no connected subnet with the speaker is retained toward an on-link external destination. No tagged 3-3 carrier exercises that exclusion. The historical 3-6 split acknowledges third-party inclusion debt but does not remove the whole iff sentence from this unannotated row. The RFC permission for internal advertisement to remove link-local does not excuse external retention when the global condition fails. Downgrade enforced to weak; no partial/gap annotation stands, and no absent feature expansion or speculative fix is proposed. RFC2545-3-4.note: (a) forbidden: a second address or a length other than 16 when the inclusion condition does not hold. (b) TestSendAnnounceOmitsLinkLocalWhenPeerOffLink asserts the global-only form with length 0x10 and NotContains the 32-octet form; new-v6.ci pins 01 10 plus one address byte for byte; conf-llnh-update.ci is the negative, asserting the field is not reduced to 16 while the condition holds.

RFC2545-3-6.note: Independently rejudged against rfc/full/rfc2545.txt Section 3: 'The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if and only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to.' The same section specifies: 'A BGP speaker shall advertise to its peer in the Network Address of Next Hop field the global IPv6 address of the next hop, potentially followed by the link-local IPv6 address of the next hop.' Current internal/component/bgp/reactor/link_scope.go::classify returns nextHopRouterSpeaker only for the connected endpoint, configured local address or held local interface address, and returns nextHopRouterThirdParty otherwise. linkLocalNextHop returns an empty address for nextHopRouterThirdParty even with peerOnLink true; the supplied configured Link-Local is the speaker's, not that third party's. applyLinkLocalNextHop therefore leaves the explicit third-party next hop in its single-address form; peer_forward_facts.go::precomputeNextHop and applyFactsNextHop select and emit its 16-byte global field. This remains the annotated include-half gap on rails that write a third party's next hop, not a newly introduced enum regression. The new default panic changes no declared router variant. The annotation correctly excludes preservation of a received pair: NextHopAuto/NextHopUnchanged select nhModeNone, applyFactsNextHop returns without rewriting, and forward_next_hop.go::egressNextHopGlobalHalf preserves an on-link destination's received pair but strips its Link-Local half for an off-link destination. No polarity tests tag this gap row. rfc2545_own_link_local_red_test.go::TestOwnLinkLocalNotPairedWithAnotherRoutersGlobalOnTheSharedLink was also read: its tag is for RFC2545-3-1, and its assertions deliberately require the third-party global alone rather than the wrong speaker-owned Link-Local; it is not proof that the missing include half is implemented. No new execution or discrimination observation is claimed.
